_about: Per-car pages that open normally for a brand with has_data=false (see data/brands.json and web/brand_gate.py). Entries are the first path segment after /v/{vin}/ (empty string = the Bench). Every other per-car page renders as an empty skeleton for such a brand. These are the pages that only keep this car's own records or say plainly that no scan is on file.
